reason: I already paid an agency for a year of reports that never turned into jobs, so a stranger from Roscoe promising a one-pager about my business is just another pitch dressed up as a favor. Maybe if the page showed real money in my own numbers I would listen, but I am not paying $250 up front to find out.
objection: The free page is a hook, and once he has got my phone number the next step is me sitting in meetings explaining my business to somebody who has never run a crew, I do not have time for that again.
would_change_my_mind: If he fixed one thing for free or no money down until the written test passes and it actually worked on a shop I know, I would take him seriously.
